phrases.text: Excuse me, could I ask you something?
phrases.tip: Variant: Excuse me, I had a quick question. / Sorry to bother you—may I ask?

phrases.text: Thanks so much for your help.
phrases.tip: Variant: I really appreciate it—thank you.

phrases.text: Do you have a minute I could borrow?
phrases.tip: Variant: Would it be alright if I take a moment of your time?

phrases.text: Could you take a look at this setting for me?
phrases.tip: Variant: Would you check this option with me?

phrases.text: I'm stuck on this—could you point me in the right direction?
phrases.tip: Variant: I hit a snag; could you give me some guidance?

phrases.text: Could I borrow a power outlet for a bit?
phrases.tip: Variant: Is there somewhere I can plug in quickly?

phrases.text: When would you have five minutes to chat?
phrases.tip: Variant: Let me know when you have a moment to talk.

phrases.text: Could we move it to tomorrow morning?
phrases.tip: Variant: Would rescheduling for tomorrow a.m. work?

phrases.text: I might be ten minutes late; I'll keep you posted.
phrases.tip: Variant: I may run a bit late—I'll let you know when I'm close.

phrases.text: Which floor and direction is ___?
phrases.tip: Variant: Could you tell me how to get to ___?

phrases.text: About how long is the walk to the metro station?
phrases.tip: Variant: Roughly how many minutes to the subway?

phrases.text: I can't find the entrance—could you point me there?
phrases.tip: Variant: Where's the entrance located?

phrases.text: Does this come with a warranty?
phrases.tip: Variant: How long is the warranty period?

phrases.text: Do you have this in other colors or styles?
phrases.tip: Variant: Are there any other options available?

phrases.text: Could I get an invoice for this?
phrases.tip: Variant: Would you be able to issue a receipt?

phrases.text: Do you have this one size up or down?
phrases.tip: Variant: Are there other sizes in stock?

phrases.text: Could I try this on or take a quick walk in it?
phrases.tip: Variant: Would it be alright if I try it on?

phrases.text: I'm a 27.5 cm—do you have that size available?
phrases.tip: Variant: Do you carry a 27.5 in this style?

phrases.text: I'd like to swap this for the same item in another color—would that be okay?
phrases.tip: Variant: Could I exchange it for a different color?

phrases.text: This one has a defect—could you help me take care of it?
phrases.tip: Variant: There's an issue here; what's the best way to handle it?

phrases.text: Do I need to bring the receipt or packaging?
phrases.tip: Variant: What paperwork do I need for a return?

phrases.text: Do you take cards or mobile payments?
phrases.tip: Variant: Which payment methods do you accept?

phrases.text: Here's my e-receipt ID—could you save it there?
phrases.tip: Variant: Please store the invoice on my barcode—thanks.

phrases.text: Could you split this into two receipts?
phrases.tip: Variant: Would it be possible to ring it up as two transactions?

phrases.text: I'd like to check on my order status.
phrases.tip: Variant: Could you see where my order is at right now?

phrases.text: The link you sent won't open—could you send it again?
phrases.tip: Variant: The link expired; could you provide a new one?

phrases.text: I'd like to cancel and get a refund—what's the process?
phrases.tip: Variant: How do I request a refund?

phrases.text: I've gathered the edits in the notes—could you take a look?
phrases.tip: Variant: Key points are in the comments; please review.

phrases.text: This request is waiting on approval—could you help move it along?
phrases.tip: Variant: We're blocked on authorization; could you assist?

phrases.text: Is there anything else you need me to add?
phrases.tip: Variant: Are you missing any information from me?

phrases.text: The faucet keeps dripping—could someone come take a look?
phrases.tip: Variant: There's a leak at the tap; could you send someone?

phrases.text: Does this run on 110V or 220V?
phrases.tip: Variant: Which voltage does this unit need—110 or 220?

phrases.text: About how long will the repair take?
phrases.tip: Variant: What's the estimated completion time?

phrases.text: No sugar, light ice, to go please—thanks!
phrases.tip: Variant: No sugar, no ice, and make it to go, please.

phrases.text: Could you leave out the spice and keep the sauce on the side?
phrases.tip: Variant: No spice, and serve the sauce separately.

phrases.text: Table for two—we'll need about an hour.
phrases.tip: Variant: Two guests; we'll be here roughly an hour.
